resolved_conflicts.explanation: The NHLR Built field says 1940, while its description says the tower was built around the late 1930s or early 1940s. The story gives 1940 as the register's stated build year and also gives the description's late-1930s-to-early-1940s range.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: NHLR is the substantive source and the Forest Lookouts Georgia list gives only county, agency and design. Status and access come from NHLR's 'appears to be abandoned' line and its note about removed steps; no newer source was found. The brief's standing status is kept with a status_note added. Two searches found no news or GFC page on this tower. Worth confirming on the ground that the tower still stands before any public use is suggested.
